raw_resume.summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience building scalable Java and Spring Boot microservices in fintech. Seeking the Software Engineer II role at Google Cloud, with a track record of optimising system performance, leading design initiatives, and mentoring junior engineers.

bullets: Reduced p95 latency of the settlement API from 800 ms to 350 ms by adding Redis caching.
Split the monolithic payouts module into 4 Spring Boot microservices communicating over REST APIs.
Mentored 2 junior engineers and conducted code reviews in 2-week Agile sprints to ensure quality and consistency.
Implemented JPA and Hibernate repositories with MySQL schema changes for the merchant onboarding service.
Automated nightly reconciliation reports, saving the operations team 6 hours per week.

profile_improvement_tips: Learn Python or JavaScript to match the JD's language requirements; your Java expertise is strong, but multi-language capability strengthens your candidacy for Google Cloud roles.

Gain hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, or Pub/Sub; your microservices and distributed systems work translates well, but GCP-specific projects will boost your profile.

Deepen your system design knowledge by documenting architectural decisions in your current role; your latency optimisation and microservices split show systems thinking, but formal design review leadership will align you with the role's expectations.
raw_resume.growth_note: You meet the minimum 1-year requirement and have strong Java and code review experience, but the JD emphasises multiple programming languages (Python, C++, JavaScript) and GCP expertise, neither of which your profile currently shows. Your fintech backend focus is solid but outside Google Cloud's typical domains (distributed computing, AI, NLP, UI). Gaining Python and GCP experience will significantly improve your fit.
